relevant_ekb_readback.control_intent: Read applicable EKB before operational/code work and block applicable High/Critical rules without controls.
Use typed/canonical bindings rather than reconstructing access ad hoc.

audit_findings.finding: v0.1 trusted rule.applicable instead of computing/validating applicability from observed context.
audit_findings.correction: v0.2 requires applicability_context and rejects declared/computed mismatch.

audit_findings.finding: v0.1 only treated HIGH/CRITICAL as blocking severities while live EKB also uses ALTA/CRITICA/P0.
audit_findings.correction: v0.2 normalizes live severity aliases before enforcement.

audit_findings.finding: Missing/malformed Card candidates could collapse to no-Card and enter fallback/manual without proving Card readback.
audit_findings.correction: v0.2 requires card_readback_present, candidate shape and provenance.

audit_findings.finding: Incomplete fallback checks could be interpreted as unavailable/unsafe and permit MANUAL_REQUIRED.
audit_findings.correction: v0.2 requires explicit booleans and evidence_ref for all three structural alternatives.

audit_findings.finding: CLI --input returned process exit 0 even for blocked/manual decisions.
audit_findings.correction: v0.2 returns exit 0 only for READY_TO_EXECUTE; blocked/manual return 3.

audit_findings.finding: Git candidate binding was previously described as operationally effective, but live Supabase CREACION_CARD_LF does not contain S26-E/PRE_EKB_GATE binding.
audit_findings.correction: Claim ceiling reduced to candidate component; live/global activation remains unverified and must not be called PASS.
